scopes.read:sent-invitations: Grants read access to sent invitations
scopes.write:sent-invitations: Grants write access to sent invitations

info.description:
Create and manage requests for a client to authorise an agent.
This draft documents only the V3 operations currently implemented. Version 3.0 is not advertised through the API definition until the V3 release is enabled.
info.title: Agent Authorisation

get.description: Returns the calling agency's invitation history. An empty history is returned as an empty array.

parameters.description: The agent reference number for the calling agency, including a valid check character.
parameters.name: arn

href.description: Relative URL of the invitation resource.

clientActionUrl.description: Link for the client to accept or reject a pending invitation.

agentType.description: The type of agent relationship. If omitted, the invitation is created for a main agent. A supporting agent type affects MTD-IT only.
